proposed_capability: At or below the verified household recovery threshold, route one automatic exact-funds bailout in an active authorized host session. Score the observed depletion without counting the cheat as earned or crediting the bailout in training.
player_save_control_impact: No change to live settings, saves or player-control authority. An unattended UI sender requires its reviewed local sensor and runner.
expected_outcome: Inclusive live threshold; canonical exact target; durable single attempt per episode; distinct HUD proof; signed deprivation and optional attributed reviewed valence.
negative_tests: No trigger at 500001; no double submission or training after replay.
Never use unknown or stale balances and never attribute player or unverified losses to automation.
Subsidy restoration is zero earned income.
rollback_path: Revert the feature; no save files edited or game activated here.
unresolved_unknowns: Exact-build verified console field and HUD capture adapter on the Windows game host.
